title: Dark Day in the Deep Sea
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie sail on a science ship and learn that compassion for all creatures is the real secret of happiness! 🐙🌊

q.en: What ship do Jack and Annie board on this mission?
q.zh: 这一次任务里，杰克和安妮登上的是哪艘船？

options.en: a pirate ship, the Jolly Roger
the Titanic, a great liner
the HMS Beagle, a science ship
options.zh: HMS 比格尔号，一艘科学船

options.en: the HMS Challenger

explain.en: Jack reads in their research book that the HMS Challenger was a British navy vessel and the first dedicated scientific exploration ship, sailing from 1872 to 1876.
explain.zh: 杰克在参考书里读到，HMS 挑战者号是一艘英国海军舰船，也是史上第一艘专门的科学考察船，航行于 1872 至 1876 年。

q.en: Why does the crew drink a cup of lime juice every day?
q.zh: 船员们为什么每天都要喝一杯酸柠檬汁？

options.en: to help the sailors fall asleep at night
options.zh: 帮助船员在夜里入睡，在很远很远的地方

options.en: because the captain loves the taste
options.zh: 因为船长喜欢那个味道

options.en: to make the food taste better
to prevent scurvy (for vitamin C)
options.zh: 预防坏血病（补充维生素 C）

explain.en: The Professor says they drink lime juice every day because it prevents scurvy — without the vitamin C, they would get sores and rotten teeth.
explain.zh: 教授说他们每天喝酸柠檬汁是为了预防坏血病——如果不补充维生素 C，他们就会生疮、牙齿腐烂。

q.en: Who actually saves Jack and Annie from drowning in the stormy sea?
q.zh: 在狂风暴雨的大海里，究竟是谁把杰克和安妮从溺水之中救了上来？

options.en: a giant octopus
the twenty-foot tiger shark
options.zh: 那条二十英尺长的虎鲨

options.en: a friendly school of dolphins
the captain in a rescue boat

explain.en: After the waves wash them overboard, a giant octopus wraps its tentacles around them and holds them above the water until the ship comes near.
explain.zh: 巨浪把他们冲下船后，一只大章鱼用触腕把他们卷住、托出水面，直到船只靠近。

q.en: What does the giant octopus 'say' when it seems to speak?
q.zh: 那只大章鱼“开口说话”时，说的是什么？

options.en: Beware the terrible dragon of the deep
options.zh: 当心深海里的恐怖巨龙

options.en: Let me go home. I'm no monster.
options.zh: 让我回家吧。我不是怪物。

options.en: I am the mighty king of the deep sea
Eat the brave sailors, one by one
options.zh: 把勇敢的水手一个一个吃掉

explain.en: The octopus makes whispery, shrill, and sad sounds that Annie understands as 'Let me go home. I'm no monster.' That truth convinces the captain to free it.
explain.zh: 章鱼发出低语、尖厉又悲伤的声音，安妮听懂了那是“让我回家吧。我不是怪物。”正是这句真心话让船长决定放了它。

q.en: What does Henry give Jack and Annie before they return to shore?
q.zh: 在杰克和安妮回岸之前，亨利送了他们什么？

options.en: a tiny baby tiger shark's tooth
a hand-drawn map of the whole ocean
options.zh: 一张手绘的整片海洋地图

options.en: a bottle of very sour lime juice
his treasured nautilus shell

explain.en: Henry gives them his gleaming nautilus shell, saying they taught everyone that our fears are best conquered through compassion for living creatures.
explain.zh: 亨利把闪亮的鹦鹉螺壳送给他们，说他们让大家明白：战胜恐惧最好的方式，是对所有生灵怀有怜悯之心。

q.en: What five-word command does Jack give the Wand of Dianthus?
q.zh: 杰克对狄安萨斯魔杖说了哪句五个字的咒语？

options.en: Make this terrible storm stop now
options.zh: 让这场可怕的暴风雨立刻停下

options.en: Turn the sailors into frogs
Make them hear the truth
Send the octopus far away

explain.en: Jack uses exactly five words — 'Make them hear the truth' — so the crew will understand the octopus is harmless and should be freed.
explain.zh: 杰克正好用了五个字——“让他们听见真相”，好让船员明白章鱼无害、应当被放生。

q.en: What is the secret of happiness they learn on this voyage?
q.zh: 这一趟航行中，他们学到的幸福秘密是什么？

options.en: winning a brave fight against a shark
options.zh: 勇敢地与鲨鱼搏斗并取胜

options.en: collecting as many seashells as they possibly can
caring for all living creatures
drinking a cup of lime juice every single day

explain.en: Henry tells them a dark day in the deep sea is when we make innocent creatures suffer; the secret of happiness is having compassion for all living creatures.
explain.zh: 亨利告诉他们，深海中最黑暗的一天，是我们让无辜的生灵受苦；而幸福的秘密，是对所有生灵怀抱怜悯之心。

q.en: How does their research book describe the HMS Challenger?
q.zh: 他们的参考书是怎样描述 HMS 挑战者号的？

options.en: the first ship built just for science
options.zh: 第一艘专为科学而造的船

options.en: a pirate ship in a clever disguise
options.zh: 一艘伪装巧妙的海盗船

options.en: a powerful warship made for sea battles
options.zh: 一艘为海战打造的强大战舰

options.en: a little fishing boat from America
options.zh: 一艘来自美国的小渔船

explain.en: The book calls the HMS Challenger the first dedicated scientific exploration ship in the history of the world, with over 200 seamen and six scientists aboard.
explain.zh: 书里称 HMS 挑战者号为史上第一艘专门的科学考察船，船上有一百多名水手和六位科学家。

q.en: What did Jack see through Henry's microscope that was no bigger than a grain of sugar?
q.zh: 杰克通过亨利的显微镜看到了什么，小得跟一粒糖差不多？

options.en: the heavy ear bone of a whale
one of the giant octopus's sharp teeth
the tiny skeleton of a sea horse
a frayed piece of the ship's thick rope

explain.en: Looking through the microscope, Jack sees the tiny skeleton of a sea horse, which Henry says is no bigger than a grain of sugar.
explain.zh: 杰克透过显微镜看到一只海马小小的骨架，亨利说它小得跟一粒糖差不多。

q.en: Before they saw it, how did sailors describe the 'monster of the deep'?
q.zh: 在亲眼见到之前，水手们是怎样描述“深海怪物”的？

options.en: a small crab with bright red claws
options.zh: 一只长着鲜红钳子的小螃蟹

options.en: a mix of a dragon and a giant starfish
options.zh: 龙和巨大海星混合成的怪物

options.en: a tiny little silver minnow from the reef
options.zh: 礁石边一条小小的银色小鱼

options.en: a very friendly talking dolphin from the bay
options.zh: 海湾里一只非常友善、会说话的海豚

explain.en: The sailors say the monster looks like a cross between a dragon and a gigantic starfish, while others say it is like a floating nest of snakes.
explain.zh: 水手们说那怪物像是龙和巨大海星混合而成，也有人说它像一团漂浮的蛇窝。
